gloss: to make light of; to underestimate; to disregard

definitions.gloss: to make light of; to underestimate; to belittle; to disregard
definitions.explanation: To treat something as less important or serious than it actually is. To fail to give proper weight or attention to something.

examples.japanese: {安全|あんぜん}を{軽視|けいし}してはいけない。
{相手|あいて}の{意見|いけん}を{軽視|けいし}するのはよくない。
examples.english: It's not good to belittle the other person's opinions.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}を{軽視|けいし}した{結果|けっか}、{大|おお}きな{病気|びょうき}にかかってしまった。
examples.english: As a result of neglecting my health, I ended up with a serious illness.

notes: Common collocations: {安全|あんぜん}を{軽視|けいし}する (to disregard safety), {人権|じんけん}を{軽視|けいし}する (to belittle human rights), {軽視|けいし}できない (cannot be taken lightly). The antonym is {重視|じゅうし}する (to regard as important, to emphasize). Related: {無視|むし}する (to ignore — stronger, implies complete disregard), {見下|みくだ}す (to look down on — directed at people), {侮|あなど}る (to underestimate — implies contemptuous dismissal).
